wire.phone_access.title: Phone access
wire.phone_access.description: How this computer keeps its Radient tunnel for the phone app working. Changes apply to the next sign-in.
wire.phone_access.auto_setup.label: Reconnect phone access after signing in
wire.phone_access.auto_setup.help: When you sign in to Radient on a computer that already has phone access, reconnect or repair its tunnel in the background. It never activates billing or spends credit; any price or missing credit is shown to you instead.
